name: Most frequent element order in the symmetric group S16
description: construct() -> an attainable permutation order k in S16. Maximize the exact number of permutations of that order. All integer partitions of 16 are enumerated and their cycle-type multiplicities 16! / product(i**m_i * m_i!) are summed by cycle-length lcm. S16 is a finite exact rediscovery specialization. Degree 16 keeps every count below 2**53 so the common floating score envelope represents integer counts exactly.

state_of_the_art.statement: In S_16 the most common order is 12, shared by 2,428,557,331,200 permutations (OEIS A061125). Enumerating all 231 cycle types (scripts/check_state_of_the_art.py) confirms that no other order is more frequent. Beker described the maximizing orders asymptotically.
